subject: Quick compatibility check before full demo — Shopperly

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@shopperly.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick compatibility check before demo?

Hi Diego,

Thanks — we signed up for a trial yesterday and Marissa from your team reached out. Before we jump into a full product demo, our engineering lead asked for a very short technical compatibility call (15 minutes) so we can confirm basic fit: networking, expected throughput, and whether Redwood has the right private deployment options for data-siloed workloads.

We’re a small infra team at Shopperly (ecommerce platform) — likely to test embeddings and chat generation for search ranking and buyer assistance. We’re PST-based and can do short windows tomorrow or early next week.

A few quick notes that matter to us:
- We’re exploring a private/VPC deployment or dedicated capacity; need an initial sense of integration effort.
- Typical sequence lengths: up to 1024 tokens for retrieval-augmented generation; spikes to 2000 tokens for longer sessions.
- We expect a POC QPS of ~5–10, peak concurrency 25.

Can we lock 15 minutes just to confirm those constraints? Calendly link from Marissa would work too. If you need anything from our side, I attached a simple architecture diagram.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Engineering Manager, Shopperly
alyssa@shopperly.com

Attachment: shopperly_arch_diagram.pdf (pdf)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 15:18:00 -07:00

Hi Alyssa — great to meet you over email, and thanks for the diagram. I’m copying Marissa (your AE) so she has context. Happy to do a focused 15-minute call to confirm those specifics.

Quick checklist items so I can tailor the call:
- Are you evaluating Hosted API first or do you already need Dedicated/Private for the POC? (you mentioned both)
- Do you have a preferred cloud region/provider (AWS us-west-2, GCP, Azure)?
- Is the 2000-token spike common or an occasional outlier?
- Any strict latency SLO for inference (p50/p95)?

Proposed slots (PST):
- Mon 09/21 10:00–10:15
- Mon 09/21 15:00–15:15
- Tue 09/22 08:30–08:45

Or my Calendly: https://calendly.com/diego-redwood/15min-compat-check — pick what works and I’ll send a calendar invite. I attached a short compatibility checklist that you can fill out beforehand if helpful.

If it’s easier, Marissa can coordinate. I’ll plan to keep this strictly focused on the integration constraints you listed.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
